privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: RouteGuard is a student project for the NH-44 Jammu–Srinagar road. This page says what we collect, why, how long we keep it and how to delete it, following India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
privacy.collectAccount: Your email address, to sign in with a one-time code. Our sign-in provider, Clerk, stores it; our database doesn't.
privacy.collectProfile: Your display name, your role (grower, trader, agent or driver) and your language.
privacy.collectReports: Road reports you send: the hazard, the place on the road, an optional note and an optional photo. We remove the photo's hidden data (EXIF), including where it was taken, before we store it.
privacy.collectShipments: Shipments you add: truck number, load, destination and status.
privacy.collectLocation: Drivers only, and only if you turn it on: your latest location, rounded to about 1 km, shared only with your own transport agent.
privacy.collectLogs: Server logs: the time, a request id and a short scrambled code instead of your user id. No message contents, photos or phone numbers.
privacy.why: To show the risk on the road, to let drivers report and confirm hazards, and to let agents follow their own trucks. We don't sell data and we don't show ads.
privacy.keep: Reports leave the map when they expire (3 to 12 hours, by type of hazard) and stay in the road history. For a driver's location we keep only the latest point, and we clear it 7 days after the delivery. The record of admin and police actions (the audit log) is kept for the length of the project and can't be changed.
privacy.consent: We ask you before turning on location sharing and before any identity check, and we record which version of this notice you agreed to. You can turn location sharing off at any time.
privacy.delete: You can delete your account. Your road reports then stay in the history without your name or user id.
privacy.emergency: RouteGuard is not an emergency service. In an emergency call 112.

advice.heading: Dispatch advisor
advice.intro: Tell us about one truckload. We check the risk on its route and say whether to send it now, hold, book rail or divert.

reason.divert_mughal: Zone {zone} is medium {when}. A light truck can take Mughal Road (Shopian to Bufliaz) instead; an admin has marked it open.
reason.rail_high: The road stays high in zone {zones} in 24 h and in 48 h, and this fruit has used {pct}% of its shelf life. Book a Budgam–Delhi parcel train slot.
reason.divert_store_valley: Zone {zone} is high {when}. Keep the lot in a cold store in the valley until it clears.
reason.divert_store: Zone {zone} is high {when}. The fruit can wait: send it to a cold store in the valley or sell at Parimpora.

report.heading: Report a road hazard
report.intro: Tell other drivers what is on NH-44 right where you are. A report from a verified driver or the police goes on the map straight away; others wait for two verified people nearby to confirm it.
report.paused: Reporting is paused for now. The map and advice still work.
report.noRole: Finish setting up your account (pick your role) before you post a report.
report.wrongRole: Road reports come from drivers, transport agents and police. Your account has a different role.
report.whereHint: We use your phone's location to put the report on the map. You must be on or near NH-44.

locateError.unavailable: Your phone could not find its location. Move to open sky and try again.

report.photoHint: Photograph the road, not people or number plates. JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to {mb} MB. We remove the location and camera details from the file.
report.noteHint: What and where, in a few words. Don't write phone numbers or truck numbers: we hide them.
report.consent: I am on the road now and this is what I see. My location is used only to place this report.
report.needs: Pick what is on the road, use your location and tick the box to send.

sent.created: Thank you. Your report is saved.
sent.merged: Someone reported this nearby a little earlier, so we counted yours as a confirmation of theirs.
sent.live: It is on the map now.
sent.waiting: It shows as unconfirmed until two verified people nearby confirm it.
